messages:
ben: Starting rollout for redwood-api v2.4.0 in the 18:00-19:00 change window. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% over 10m, monitor latency and errors.
deploy-bot: preflight checks running...
deploy-bot: PRECHECK FAIL: values.schema mismatch at /database/pool (expected integer, got string)
ben: weird, I just rebased the values PR. @marta can you confirm the canary values file? :eyes:
marta: looking now
marta: found it — pool: "20" in charts/redwood/values-canary.yaml. YAML templating emitted it as string.
marta: I can push a quick fix but it won't make this window unless we hotpatch
yuki: do we have a clean rollback if we proceed? last rollback we did hit hook-run issues
raj: confirmed. this chart has a post-install DB-resize hook; rolling back while the hook ran caused stuck jobs previously
olivia: note for release notes: call out DB pool change and that it requires a migration step, so we should be conservative here
ben: proposal: abort this canary, pin chart version on the release branch to the last known-good chart (2.4.0-rc3), and open a follow-up hotfix PR to normalize the pool value to an int in the template. objections?
sara: +1 — safer to abort. we avoid a potentially non-idempotent hook running in prod.
raj: agree. also can we add a preflight test for numeric types in values schema so this doesn't slip through?
deploy-bot: action queued: aborting rollout per @ben
deploy-bot: rollout aborted — canary not applied. reason: preflight values.schema mismatch (/database/pool)
ben: thanks. @sara can you open the chart-pin PR to lock chart:2.4.0-rc3 for the release branch? please include a line in the PR description for release notes: "chart pinned due to values schema compatibility"
sara: on it, creating PR now
sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/432 — pins chart to 2.4.0-rc3 on release/redwood-api-2.4.0 branch
sara: patch diff snippet:
```
Chart.yaml
- version: 2.4.0
+ version: 2.4.0 (pinned 2.4.0-rc3)
```
ben: once PR merges, we can re-run the deploy in the next quiet window (tomorrow 02:00 UTC) or do a hotpatch if urgency is high
marta: i'll also open a follow-up PR to coerce pool -> int in template and add a unit test against the values schema.
olivia: drafting release notes now — will add a section: "Abort during canary: chart pinned for compatibility; follow-up hotfix planned."
ben: TL;DR: abort, pin chart, follow-up hotfix PR for values template, re-run in next window or hotpatch if needed
raj: noted. adding post-deploy checklist item: ensure preflight validates number-like strings -> typed numbers
deploy-bot: reminder set: re-run preflight after PR merge and schedule deploy automatically when checks pass
ben: thanks all :pray:
olivia: I'll add an entry in the release tracker and ping support to expect the delay
marta: pushing the template fix in a minute; will link the PR here when ready
sara: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/432 (merged)
deploy-bot: deploy queued: awaiting preflight pass and next change window confirmation
ben: confirm re-run for tomorrow 02:00 UTC
olivia: release notes live draft: https://intranet.redwood.com/releases/2026-03-21/redwood-api-2.4.0 — added abort+pin section
ben: closing this thread. follow-ups are the two PRs and the postmortem checklist item. If anything changes, re-open an incident thread. Thanks everyone.
